<TITLE>EX-10.9</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.9 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Employment
Agreement (this <B>&#8220;Agreement&#8221;</B>) is entered into as of May&nbsp;22, 2026 (the <B>&#8220;Commencement Date&#8221;</B>), by and between CalPrivate Bank, a California corporation, its successors and permitted assigns (collectively, the
<B>&#8220;Bank&#8221;</B>), and Richard L. Sowers (<B>&#8220;Executive&#8221;</B>), with reference to the following: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A. Executive and the
Bank entered into that certain Employment Agreement dated April&nbsp;29, 2023, as amended by the Amendment to Employment Agreement dated April&nbsp;27, 2026 and the Second Amendment to Employment Agreement dated May&nbsp;14, 2026 (&#8220;<B>Prior
Employment Agreement</B>&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">B. The Prior Employment Agreement expires according to its terms on May&nbsp;22, 2026; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">C. Executive and the Bank desire to memorialize their agreement that the Prior Employment Agreement has expired by its terms and is replaced
as of the Commencement Date with this Agreement; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">D. The Bank considers the retention of Executive&#8217;s services, managerial skills,
and business experience to be in the best interests of the Bank and its shareholder and desires to obtain the services of Executive on behalf of the Bank on the terms and conditions set forth herein; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">E. The Bank and Executive desire to enter into a formal agreement setting forth the terms and conditions of Executive&#8217;s employment,
including outlining Executive&#8217;s general duties as President and Chief Executive Officer of the Bank, and setting Executive&#8217;s compensation for services in such capacities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, promises and obligations set forth herein, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby
acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Employment</U>. The Bank and Executive hereby acknowledge that the Prior Employment
Agreement expires according to its terms on May&nbsp;22, 2026 and that all compensation obligations under the Prior Employment Agreement have been satisfied. The Bank hereby agrees to employ Executive, and Executive agrees to be employed by the
Bank, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, from the Commencement Date through the day prior to the third anniversary of the Commencement Date (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Expiration Date</B><B>&#8221;</B>), provided that
(i)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank can be terminated at the will of either Executive or the Bank at any time, with or without notice, Cause or Good Reason, before the Expiration Date pursuant to <U>Paragraphs 4 and 5</U> and
(ii)&nbsp;if Executive continues to be employed under this Agreement as of the Expiration Date, the Expiration Date shall be automatically extended for one additional year unless at least 120 days prior to the Expiration Date, the Bank has given
written notice to Executive that the Agreement shall not be automatically extended. Executive shall serve as the Bank&#8217;s President and Chief Executive Officer and shall have duties, authority, and responsibilities as described herein and as
shall be from time to time prescribed by the Bank&#8217;s Board of Directors (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Board</B><B>&#8221;</B>). Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank shall automatically terminate on the Expiration Date and, subject to
<U>Paragraph</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.14</U>, this Agreement shall be of no force or effect thereafter, unless Executive and the Bank have entered into an amendment of this Agreement extending the Expiration Date, as set forth in <U>Paragraph 9.2</U>.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Duties</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.1
<U>Best Efforts</U>. Executive shall faithfully discharge Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities to the best of Executive&#8217;s abilities, with reasonable diligence, and shall abide by all policies, procedures and decisions made by the
Bank, as well as all applicable federal, state and local laws, regulations and ordinances. During Executive&#8217;s employment, Executive shall act in the best interests of the Bank at all times; shall devote substantially all of Executive&#8217;s
business time and attention to the business and affairs of the Bank; and shall not have other employment, consulting, or independent contractor work that directly or indirectly: (i)&nbsp;conflicts with the interests of the Bank; (ii)&nbsp;negatively
affects Executive&#8217;s job performance; or (iii)&nbsp;materially infringes upon the time required by Executive to faithfully perform Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities to the best of Executive&#8217;s ability. In order to ensure that
no conflict exists, Executive agrees not to engage in any outside employment, consulting, or independent contractor work of any kind without the prior written approval of the Board that shall not be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding any
provision to the contrary, the Board has <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-approved</FONT> (and no other approval shall be required) for Executive to serve on the board of directors for (i)&nbsp;Munifi; (ii) Doublecheck Systems; and
(iii)&nbsp;the California Bankers Association for so long as the Executive desires, so long as these positions are not deemed by the Board in its sole discretion to be interfering with the conduct of his duties at the Bank. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.2 <U>Authority</U>. Executive shall exercise such authority, perform such executive duties
and functions and discharge such responsibilities as are reasonably associated with Executive&#8217;s position as President and Chief Executive Officer, commensurate with the authority vested in Executive pursuant to this Agreement and consistent
with the bylaws of the Bank and resolutions of the Board with respect to the authority of specific executive officers as in effect from time to time. Executive has been elected to the Board and shall be nominated for election to the Board, to the
extent consistent with the Board&#8217;s fiduciary duties, while employed under this Agreement, while he holds the position of Chief Executive Officer and as long as a Change in Control has not occurred, provided that Executive shall not be included
in any deliberations or vote with respect to Executive&#8217;s employment, benefits, compensation, discipline or duties to the Bank. Executive shall not be entitled to receive any additional compensation for his services as a director, officer or
employee of the Bank or of any parent entity holding at least 50% of the outstanding voting power of the Bank (a &#8220;<B>Holding Company</B>&#8221;) or of any subsidiary of the Bank or any Holding Company. The Bank and Executive acknowledge that
as of the date of this Agreement, the Bank is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Private Bancorp of America, Inc. (&#8220;<B>PBAM</B>&#8221;), which is therefore the Bank&#8217;s Holding Company, and the parties agree and confirm that Executive has been
appointed as President and Chief Executive Officer of PBAM, and that he is required under this Agreement to perform the duties required of him by the PBAM board of directors and under the PBAM corporate governance documentation, as his performance
of his duties to PBAM is material to the Bank. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.3 <U>Interests in Other Financial Services Companies</U>. During his employment with the
Bank, Executive will not provide services to, hold or make any investment in or loan to, or participate in the management or business of, any proposed or operating bank, savings and loan, credit union, thrift and loan, industrial loan or other
entity engaged in the business of making loans or accepting deposits or both, or any holding company, subsidiary or affiliate of any such entity (other than the Bank or the Bank&#8217;s Holding Company or a subsidiary of either of them), or any
investment fund with an objective of investing in or forming any such entity, without the consent of the Board; provided that Executive may own less than 1% of the voting stock of any company that files reports under the Securities Exchange Act of
1934 and Executive may own less than 0.5% of any company not filing such reports. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Compensation and Benefits</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.1 <U>Salary</U>. The Bank shall pay Executive a minimum annualized salary at the rate of $675,000, less required deductions and taxes, due
and payable in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s policy for the scheduling of salary payments to employees as in effect from time to time and applicable wage payment and tax laws (the <B>&#8220;</B><B>Base Salary</B><B>&#8221;</B>). The Base Salary
shall be evaluated on an annual basis by the Board and may be adjusted by the Board in its sole discretion, provided that any reduction shall only be with the written consent of Executive. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.2 <U>Withholding and Deductions</U>. The Bank shall withhold and/or deduct from any and all compensation, salary or other payments, all
taxes and other deductions required to be deducted or withheld under any provision of law (including, but not limited to, social security payments and income tax withholding) now in effect or which may become effective any time during
Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.3 <U>Automobile</U>. The Bank shall provide Executive with an automobile allowance at the
rate of $18,000 per annum, for a luxury automobile for business and personal use in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s policies and procedures as in effect from time to time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.4 <U>Expense Reimbursement</U>. The Bank agrees to reimburse Executive for all ordinary and necessary documented expenses incurred by
Executive on behalf of the Bank in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s policies and procedures as in effect from time to time, including entertainment, meal, and travel expenses (but excluding expenses in connection with Executive&#8217;s automobile,
including, but not limited to, expenses for insurance, fuel, maintenance, repair and registration). Any reimbursements or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits provided under this Agreement that are subject to Section&nbsp;409A
(&#8220;<B>409A</B>&#8221;) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (&#8220;<B>Code</B>&#8221;), shall be made or provided in compliance with the requirements of 409A, including, where applicable, the requirement that (i)&nbsp;any
reimbursement is for expenses incurred during the period of time specified in this Agreement, (ii)&nbsp;the amount of expenses eligible for reimbursement, or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits provided, during a fiscal year may
not affect the expenses eligible for reimbursement or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits to be provided, in any other fiscal year, (iii)&nbsp;the reimbursement of an eligible expense will be made no later than the last day of
the fiscal year following the year in which the expense is incurred, and (iv)&nbsp;the right to reimbursement or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits is not subject to liquidation or exchange for another benefit. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.5 <U>Benefits</U>. Executive will be entitled to participate in any employee benefit plan
that the Bank has adopted or may adopt, maintain or contribute to for the benefit of its employees generally, subject to satisfying the applicable eligibility requirements and paying any required <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">co-pay,</FONT>
premium or other cost, and provided that the Bank shall pay all premiums for health, dental and vision insurance offered by the Bank. The Bank may, in its sole discretion and from time to time, amend or eliminate any of these benefits. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.6 <U>Country Club</U>. The Bank shall pay the Executive an allowance of up to $1,250 per month for private club dues and expenses, and shall
pay up to and or reimburse Executive for costs incurred up to $75,000 of any country club equity ownership, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;buy-in&#8221;</FONT> or &#8220;security&#8221; requirement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.7 <U>Flexible Work Schedule</U>. The Bank does not provide paid vacation or paid time off (PTO) benefits; however, Executive is encouraged
to utilize the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. In order to provide Executive with a flexible work schedule, the Bank shall allow Executive the ability to decide when and how much time to take off, without loss of pay, subject to the
Bank&#8217;s business needs and Executive&#8217;s ability to meet those needs, in accordance with the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. Executive understands and acknowledges that time off under the Flexible Work Schedule policy is not a
form of wages earned and that it will not vest, accrue, or be paid out at the termination of Executive&#8217;s employment. Executive agrees that Executive must schedule flexible time off in accordance with, and subject to the terms and conditions
of, the Bank&#8217;s Flexible Work Schedule policy. The parties agree that Executive&#8217;s work schedule is subject to the prior approval of the Chairman of the Board. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.8 [Intentionally Omitted]. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.9 <U>Annual Incentive Bonus.</U> Beginning for calendar 2026, Executive will be eligible for an annual incentive bonus (an &#8220;<B>Annual
Incentive Bonus</B>&#8221;), with a target amount (the &#8220;<B>Target Annual Incentive Bonus Amount</B>&#8221;), based 80% on corporate metrics and 20% on personal metrics, of 50% of Executive&#8217;s Base Salary, with a maximum of 200% of the
Target Annual Incentive Bonus Amount. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Corporate and personal performance metrics, in part, shall be formulaic in nature and generally not subject to
exceptions, which formulas will be set annually by the Board in its sole discretion after consultation with and input from Executive, provided that the corporate financial performance metrics target shall be based on either performance exceeding the
65th percentile of a national peer group&#8217;s performance or the attainment of strategic objectives determined by the Compensation, Governance, and Nominating Committee (or its successor) (the &#8220;Committee) after consultation with, and input
from, the Executive. The national peer group shall be selected by Pearl Meyer, the current compensation consultant retained by the Committee to advise on the compensation of the President and Chief Executive Officer, or by a successor consultant to
the Board or a committee of the Board, after consultation with, and input from, the Executive. Partial achievement of any metric shall result in pro rata recognition of such achievement (generally using straight line linear interpolation where
applicable) in calculating the Annual Incentive Bonus based on thresholds set by the Board or a committee of the Board. The calculation of the Annual Incentive Bonus as to any particular year shall be made by the Board or a committee of the Board,
which determination shall be final and binding. Before an Annual Incentive Bonus is earned by Executive, both of the following conditions must be satisfied, as determined by the Board or a committee of the Board: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.9.1 A &#8220;Clawback Event,&#8221; as defined by the Clawback Policy of the Bank and PBAM as in effect at the date of the Board&#8217;s
determination (the &#8220;Clawback Policy&#8221;) or any similar definition in any successor or replacement policy, shall not have occurred at any time while Executive has served as Chief Executive Officer. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.9.2 Because the Annual Incentive Bonus is a retention incentive, Executive is employed by (or providing service to) the Bank or any of its
affiliate at the time the Annual Incentive Bonus is paid, except as provided in <U>Paragraphs 5.4 and 5.5.1</U>. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Annual Incentive Bonus, if any, will be advanced to Executive within two and <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-half</FONT> months after the end of the applicable calendar year, subject to clawback pursuant to <U>Paragraph 5.8.2 </U>if a determination is made by the Board that one or both of the above conditions have not been
satisfied and, therefore, the Annual Incentive Bonus, or a portion thereof, has not been earned by Executive. In addition, should the information required to fully evaluate whether the conditions in <U>Paragraph 3.9.1</U> have been met is not
available prior to the advance, and it is later determined by the Board or a committee of the Board that either of the conditions was not in fact met, notwithstanding any provision herein to the contrary (i)&nbsp;from the date of such determination,
while Executive continues to be employed by the Bank, Executive&#8217;s Base Salary shall be reduced by 25% per month until Executive either returns the Annual Incentive Bonus, or the full amount is recaptured via such reduction in Base Salary; and
(ii)&nbsp;at such time as Executive is no longer employed by the Bank the balance shall be immediately due and payable. Neither the withholding of the Annual Incentive Bonus nor any other remedy shall be the exclusive remedy of the Bank. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.10 <U>Long-Term Incentive Plan Equity Bonus</U>. Executive shall be entitled to be awarded restricted stock units in the form and on terms
provided to other executives (&#8220;<B>LTIP Awards</B>&#8221;) under the Bank&#8217;s and Holding Company&#8217;s Long-Term Incentive Plan, as in effect from time to time (the &#8220;<B>LTIP Plan</B>&#8221;) each calendar year in an amount up to
50% of his Base Salary (the &#8220;<B>Target Award</B>&#8221;) should the LTIP Awards become fully vested and payable at the target amount payable. The Board or a Board committee shall have the authority to grant additional LTIP Awards up to an
additional 50% of the Target Award set in the succeeding year to reward truly exceptional performance in a prior year. The terms of the LTIP Awards shall be set each year by the Board or a Board committee, in its sole discretion. To vest in an LTIP
Award the Executive must remain employed by the Bank through the vesting date, subject to the terms of the LTIP Plan. The Bank notes that the LTIP Plan contains specific provisions regarding the effects of a &#8220;Change of Control,&#8221; as
defined in the LTIP Plan. Executive acknowledges that the LTIP Award due to be awarded to him in calendar 2026 was made prior to the date of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11 <U>Award of Stock Options</U>. Within five days after the commencement of the next trading window under the PBAM and Bank Insider
Trading Policy, and after shareholder approval of the PBAM 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, if approved by the PBAM shareholders, Executive shall be granted an option to purchase an additional 30,000 shares of PBAM common stock (the
&#8220;<B>Option</B>&#8221;). The Option shall be granted pursuant to and/or subject to the terms of the PBAM 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, subject to <U>Paragraph 5.5.1</U>, and shall have a maximum term of 10 years. The Option shall vest, if
at all, on the date PBAM 2028 audited financial statements are delivered to PBAM, provided Executive continues to be employed by (or provide service to) the Bank or any of its affiliates on that date (the &#8220;<B>Cliff-Vesting Date</B>&#8221;).
The portion of the Option that shall vest on the Cliff-Vesting Date, if any, shall be calculated as follows. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.1 The &#8220;<B>Annual
Earnings Goal</B>&#8221; for a year shall mean that the annual PBAM earnings per share on a fully diluted basis for a year (&#8220;<B>Earnings</B>&#8221;) meet the following goals in 2026, 2027 and 2028, respectively: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) For 2026, Earnings increase 5% or more compared to 2025 Earnings; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) For 2027, Earnings increase by 5% of the greater of the actual Earnings for 2026 and the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) For 2028, Earnings increase by 5% of the greater of the actual Earnings for 2027 and the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.2 As to 10,000 shares, the Option shall vest at the Cliff-Vesting Date if (i)&nbsp;the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal is met as of <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2026, or (ii)&nbsp;if the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal is not met as of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2026, the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal is met as of
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2027. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.3 As to 10,000 shares, the Option shall vest at the Cliff-Vesting Date if
(i)&nbsp;the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal is met as of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2027, or (ii)&nbsp;if the Annual Earnings Goal is not met as of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2027, (x) the 2028 Annual Earnings
Goal is met as of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2028 and (y)&nbsp;as to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2026 the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal was met. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.4 As to 10,000 shares, the Option shall vest at the Cliff-Vesting Date if the 2028
Annual Earnings Goal is met as of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-end</FONT> 2028. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.5 For example: If the Earnings in 2026 are
5% or greater than the 2025 Earnings, on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will vest as to the first 10,000 shares under Paragraph 3.11.2. If Earnings in 2027 grow by an additional 7% over 2026, on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will vest as to
the second 10,000 shares under Paragraph 3.11.3. If Earnings in 2028 grow by an additional 4% in 2028 (the actual Earnings in 2027 were higher than the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal), on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will not vest as to the last
10,000 shares under Paragraph 3.11.4. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.6 As another example: If the Earnings in 2026 are only 2% greater than the 2025 Earnings, but
as to 2027, Earnings compared to the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal increase by 15%, so that the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal is met, on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will vest as to the first 10,000 shares under Paragraph 3.11.2(ii). Under Paragraph
3.11.3, on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option would also vest as to the second 10,000 shares. If Earnings in 2028 grow by less than 3% for 2028 compared to 2027, the Annual Earnings Goal would not be met and at the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option
would not vest as to the final 10,000 shares. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.11.7 As another example: If the Earnings in 2026 are 35% greater than the 2025 Earnings
the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal is met, and on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will vest as to the first 10,000 shares under Paragraph 3.11.2(i). However, in 2027, Earnings increase only 1% compared to 2026 (the actual Earnings in 2026 were higher
than the 2026 Annual Earnings Goal), so the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal is not met. However, in 2028, Earnings increase 5% compared to the 2027 Annual Earnings Goal (which is higher than the actual 2027 Earnings). In this case, under Paragraphs
3.11.3(ii) and 3.11.4 on the Cliff-Vesting Date, the Option will vest as to the second and last 10,000 shares. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.12 <U>Directors and
Officers Insurance</U>. During the term of this Agreement, the Bank agrees to maintain, at the Bank&#8217;s sole expense, directors and officers liability insurance to protect Executive from liability resulting from the performance of his duties
hereunder and as a member of the Board. The determination of the amount of coverage shall be at the sole discretion of the Board. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.
<U>Termination</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.1 <U>Employer Right to Terminate Employment</U>. Subject to <U>Paragraph 5</U>, the Board has the right to
terminate the employment of Executive with the Bank prior to the Expiration Date at will, with or without Cause, including but not limited to, in connection with a Disability of Executive if in accordance with applicable law, upon delivery of
written notice to Executive (except in the case of death of Executive, in which event termination shall automatically occur at the date of death), and if termination of employment is with Cause or due to Disability, such notice shall state the
reason for termination. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.2 <U>Termination by Executive</U>. Executive may terminate Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank prior to
the Expiration Date at will, with or without notice, or Good Reason. Although not required, it is requested that Executive deliver written notice to the Bank one month in advance of the date such termination is to take effect where possible. In the
event of such termination, all compensation and benefits shall cease as of the date Executive ceases providing services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.3
<U>Termination Upon Expiration</U>. If Executive remains employed under this Agreement through the Expiration Date, and if Executive and the Bank have not entered into an amendment of this Agreement extending the Expiration Date or another written
agreement replacing this Agreement, Executive&#8217;s employment shall automatically terminate on the Expiration Date. Nothing in this paragraph&nbsp;shall prejudice the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">at-will</FONT> status of Executive or require
the Bank to negotiate with Executive. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.4 <U>Automatic Resignations</U>. If Executive&#8217;s employment by the Bank terminates for any
reason, including without limitation, the termination of Executive with or without Cause or the resignation of Executive, Executive shall, automatically and without further action by any party, be deemed to have resigned from all directorships,
offices and other capacities with the Bank and any of its subsidiaries and affiliates, including any Holding </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
Company and affiliates of any Holding Company. Executive agrees to provide any documentation confirming such resignations to the Bank immediately upon request. If Executive fails to submit any
documentation confirming such resignations to the Bank immediately upon request, this <U>Paragraph 4.4</U> shall constitute Executive&#8217;s written notice to the Board that Executive is resigning from all directorships, offices and other
capacities with the Bank and as aforesaid, effective immediately. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5 <U>Termination Date</U>. Executive&#8217;s &#8220;<B>Termination
Date</B>&#8221; shall be: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.1 If the Executive terminates his employment hereunder with or without Good Reason, the date Executive
ceases providing services; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.2 If the Bank terminates the Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder for Cause, the date the notice of
termination is delivered to the Executive; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.3 If the Bank terminates the Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder without Cause, the
date specified in the notice of termination, which shall be no less than 30 days following the date on which the notice of termination is delivered; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.4 If the Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder terminates on account of the Executive&#8217;s death, the date of the Executive&#8217;s
death; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.5 If the Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder is terminated on account of the Executive&#8217;s Disability, the date that
is specified in the notice of termination; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4.5.6 If the Executive&#8217;s employment hereunder terminates upon expiration of the
Agreement, the Expiration Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding anything contained herein, the Termination Date shall not occur until the date on which the Executive
incurs a &#8220;separation from service&#8221; within the meaning of 409A. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Post-Termination Payments and Benefits</U>. The
following, which are all subject to <U>Paragraph 5.8</U>, are the post-termination payments and benefits to which Executive is entitled upon termination of employment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.1 <U>Termination for Cause</U>. If the employment of Executive is terminated for Cause, the Bank shall provide Executive only the unpaid
earned compensation due at the end of the month in which the Termination Date occurs, which shall be paid on the Termination Date. For this purpose, any bonus compensation, including any Annual Incentive Bonus and LTIP Awards, that have not been
paid shall not be deemed unpaid earned compensation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.1.1 <U>Cause</U>. For purposes of this Agreement, <B>&#8220;Cause&#8221;</B>
means (i)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s act of embezzlement, fraud, or breach of fiduciary duty to the Bank or Holding Company, (ii)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s habitual neglect of duties (other than as a result of Disability or death), (iii) Executive&#8217;s
deliberate disregard of the written policies of the Bank or Holding Company that were made available to Executive and which results in a material loss, damage or injury to the Bank or Holding Company, (iv)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s disclosure of any of
the Trade Secrets and other Proprietary and Confidential Information of the Bank, that is outside of the scope of Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities in his capacity as President and Chief Executive Officer, (v)&nbsp;other than in
accordance with Bank policies and in further of Executive&#8217;s duties and responsibilities in his capacity as President and Chief Executive Officer, inducing any client or customer of the Bank to break any contract with the Bank or inducing any
principal for whom the Bank acts as agent to terminate such agency relations, (vi)&nbsp;engaging in any conduct which constitutes competition with the Bank, (vi)&nbsp;imposition of a regulatory order to remove Executive from his offices,
(vi)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s willful failure to comply with a lawful direction by the Board, or (vii)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s material breach of this Agreement. In no event shall Cause exist unless the Board first provides the Executive with written
notice of the circumstances that it believes give rise to Cause and provides the Executive with 30 days to cure those circumstances. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.2 <U>Termination Resulting from Disability</U>. If the employment of Executive is
terminated due to Disability, the Bank shall provide Executive only the following: (i)&nbsp;the Base Salary due at the end of the month in which the Termination Date occurs, which shall be paid on the Termination Date; (ii)&nbsp;six months of
continued Base Salary, payable monthly; and (iii)&nbsp;reimbursement for COBRA premiums for a period of up to six months following the date of termination; all provided that a full and complete release of claims against the Bank and its affiliates
in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within 45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release and provided that Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration or other dispute resolution procedure against the
Bank or any of its affiliates.<B> </B>As used in this Agreement,<B> &#8220;Disability,&#8221;</B> means an inability to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, by reason of any medically determinable
physical or mental impairment that can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months as determined by the Board. Any question as to the existence of Executive&#8217;s Disability as to which Executive and the Board cannot
agree shall be determined in writing by a qualified independent physician mutually acceptable to the Executive and the Board. If Executive and the Board cannot agree as to a qualified independent physician, each shall appoint such a physician and
those two physicians shall select a third who shall make such determination in writing. The determination of Disability made in writing to the Board and Executive shall be final and conclusive for all purposes of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.3 <U>Termination Resulting from Death</U>. If the employment of Executive is terminated due to death, the Bank shall provide only the
following: (i)&nbsp;to the Beneficiary, as defined herein, the Base Salary due Executive at the end of the month in which the Termination Date occurs; (ii)&nbsp;three months of continued Base Salary, payable monthly; and (iii)&nbsp;reimbursement for
COBRA premiums to the persons covered at the date of death (other than Executive for a period of six months following the date of death. <B>&#8220;Beneficiary&#8221;</B> means the person or entity to receive rights or benefits under this Agreement,
as set forth in this Agreement, in the event of the death of Executive. Executive hereby designates Mari L. Brusseau as the Beneficiary until Executive notifies the Bank in a signed writing otherwise. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.4 <U>Termination by the Bank Without Cause or by Executive for Good Reason</U>. If the employment of Executive is terminated by the Bank
without Cause (other than due to death or Disability), or by Executive for Good Reason, the Bank shall provide Executive only the following: (i)&nbsp;any accrued but unpaid earned compensation, which shall be paid on the Termination Date, and for
the avoidance of doubt shall include any unpaid Annual Incentive Bonus related to the prior calendar year and any other cash compensation payable in the calendar year in which the Termination Date occurs with respect to the prior calendar year that
has not been paid, (ii) 18 months of continued Base Salary, payable monthly, (iii)&nbsp;payment over a 12 month period, of the Target Annual Incentive Bonus Amount that Executive could have earned for the calendar year in which the Termination Date
occurs under the most recently approved annual incentive bonus plan, if any, with payments commencing, within two months of the Termination Date, and (iv)&nbsp;the Bank shall reimburse Executive for COBRA premiums for up to 12 months following the
date of termination by the Bank without Cause or by Executive for Good Reason; all provided that a full and complete release of claims against the Bank and its affiliates in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within
45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release and provided that Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration or other dispute resolution procedure against the Bank or any of its affiliates. This Paragraph 5.4 shall apply only with respect
to a termination of employment occurring prior to a Change in Control. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.4.1 <U>Good Reason</U>. &#8220;<B>Good Reason</B>&#8221; means
any one of the following events described in any of the following subparts (any one of which will constitute &#8220;Good Reason&#8221;) has first occurred without Executive&#8217;s written consent: (i)&nbsp;a reduction of 5% or more in
Executive&#8217;s Base Salary below the rate then in effect in accordance with Paragraph 3.1, provided that in the event the salaries of all executives with the title of Executive Vice President or above are reduced by at least 5% (but no more than
10%) on the authority of the Board such a reduction shall not constitute &#8220;Good Reason&#8221;; (ii) the Bank requiring that Executive be based outside of Los Angeles County, Orange County or San Diego County (excluding travel for Employer
business and other temporary relocations of no more than thirty (30)&nbsp;days individually), or the Employer requiring that Executive work out of San Diego County for more than two (2)&nbsp;days per week on average in any calendar quarter,
(iii)&nbsp;a material breach by the Bank of this Agreement, including without limitation a material diminution in Executive&#8217;s title, responsibilities, duties or authority (but not a reduction or change in title and/or a change in reporting
responsibilities with respect to a Change in Control Termination). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no Good Reason shall exist unless (A)&nbsp;Executive has given written notice to the Bank of the existence of the Good Reason event affecting Executive
within ninety (90)&nbsp;days of its initial existence, (B)&nbsp;the Bank has been provided a period of at least thirty (30)&nbsp;days to remedy the Good Reason event and has not remedied the Good Reason event, and (C)&nbsp;if the Bank fails to
remedy the Good Reason event during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">30-day</FONT> cure period, Executive terminates employment within thirty (30)&nbsp;days following the end of such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">30-day</FONT> cure period.
Executive&#8217;s failure to timely provide such written notice to Bank or Executive&#8217;s failure to timely resign Executive&#8217;s employment for Good Reason means that Executive will be deemed to have consented to and waived the Good Reason
event. If the Bank does timely cure or remedy the Good Reason event, then Executive may either resign Executive&#8217;s employment without Good Reason or continue to remain employed subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">7 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5 <U>Change in Control </U><U>Termination</U>. If the employment of Executive is
terminated (i)&nbsp;by the Bank without Cause (excluding death or Disability) or by Executive for Good Reason within eighteen (18)&nbsp;months after the consummation of a Change in Control, as defined in <U>Paragraph 5.5.4</U> (a &#8220;<B>Change in
Control Termination</B>&#8221;); then the Bank shall commence payment to Executive of the Change in Control Severance Benefits, as defined in <U>Paragraph 5.5.1</U>, within 60 days after the Change in Control Termination, provided, in each case,
that: (i)&nbsp;a full and complete release of claims against the Bank and its affiliates in the form of <U>Exhibit A</U> is executed and delivered to the Bank within 45 days of Executive&#8217;s receipt of the release of claims); and
(ii)&nbsp;Executive has not initiated any suit, arbitration or other dispute resolution procedure against the Bank or any of its affiliates. Change in Control Severance Benefits shall not be payable with respect to a Change in Control Termination
occurring more than eighteen (18)&nbsp;months after the date of a Change in Control. Termination of employment at the Expiration Date shall not be deemed a Change in Control Termination. Change in Control Severance Benefits shall not be payable if
as of the date of the Change in Control or thereafter prior to the Change in Control Termination, this Agreement has been amended to reflect a change in the role of the Executive, or terminated, with the consent of Executive. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5.1 <U>&#8220;</U><U>Change in Control Severance Benefits</U>.&#8221; In the case of a Change in Control Termination, the Bank shall
provide Executive with the following: (i)&nbsp;any accrued but unpaid earned compensation, which shall be paid on the Termination Date, and for the avoidance of doubt shall include any unpaid Annual Incentive Bonus related to the prior calendar year
and any other cash compensation payable in the calendar year in which the Termination Date occurs with respect to the prior calendar year that has not been paid, (ii) 24 months of continued Base Salary, payable monthly, (iii)&nbsp;if either
(x)&nbsp;Executive remained employed by the Bank or its successor in interest for at least 90 days following the Change in Control, or (y)&nbsp;Executive&#8217;s employment with the Bank or its successor in interest terminated prior to the
expiration of such 90 day period, as a result of termination of employment by the Bank or its successor in interest or termination for Good Reason by Executive, the full Target Annual Incentive Bonus Amount that Executive could have earned with
respect to the calendar year in which the Termination Date occurs, under the most recently approved annual incentive bonus plan, if any, payable over 12 months commencing 90 days after the Termination Date; (iv)&nbsp;reimbursement of COBRA premiums
for a period of up to 18 months following the Termination Date; and (v)&nbsp;all equity incentive compensation granted by the Holding Company after the Commencement Date (for the avoidance of doubt, excluding the LTIP Plan, which is subject to the
provisions of <U>Paragraph 3.10</U> only), including but not limited to, any unvested portion of the Option, shall be deemed fully vested. The parties agree to document the requirements in subsection (v)&nbsp;either within the PBAM 2026 Omnibus
Equity Incentive Plan or otherwise. Such Change in Control Severance Benefits shall be in lieu of and not in addition to any otherwise applicable compensation that would be provided under <U>Paragraph 5.4</U> notwithstanding any contrary provisions
of that paragraph. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:18%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.5.2 <U>Golden Parachute Limitations</U>. The payments and benefits provided under this <U>Paragraph 5.5</U> shall
be considered to be in full and complete satisfaction of any and all rights that Executive may enjoy under the terms of this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision of this Agreement, if any of the payments or benefits
received or to be received by Executive (including, without limitation, any payment or benefits received in connection with a Change in Control or Executive&#8217;s termination of employment, all such payments collectively referred to herein as the
&#8220;<B>280G Payments</B>&#8221;) constitute &#8220;parachute payments&#8221; within the meaning of Section&nbsp;280G of the Code and would, be subject to the excise tax imposed under Section&nbsp;4999 of the Code (the &#8220;<B>Excise
Tax</B>&#8221;), then such 280G Payments shall be reduced in a manner determined by the Bank (by the minimum possible amounts) that is consistent with the requirements of Section&nbsp;409A until no amount payable to Executive will be subject to the
Excise Tax. If two economically equivalent amounts are subject to reduction but are payable at different times, the amounts shall be reduced (but not below zero) on a pro rata basis. </P>
